messages:
nina: quick follow-up from the Vanguard/Helios combined postmortem — collecting final owners for remediation items (peering flaps + on-prem conntrack exhaustion).

raj: short list please: what are the immediate actions vs longer-term? CS needs a one-paragraph customer note.

nina: immediate: raised conntrack headroom, paused peering rollouts for affected tenants, added temporary alert threshold. owner: claire.

claire: taking the NAT audit + hotfix. i'll submit ANA-600 by EOD and PR for conntrack defaults.

derek: i'll own peering stability fixes (retry/backoff + metrics). creating ASH-2022. plan: patch branch in 10d, canary 3d after.

raj: detection: add `controlplane.route-divergence-ms` alert and `net.peering.resets` P1 rule (>2 resets/10m). owner: raj. prototype pushed to staging.

nina: automation: ops-bot to run rollback if tenant resets>3 in 15m. owner: derek + infra. dry-run for 2 weeks.

olivia: CS blurb for customers: 48h mitigation verified; fixes ETA 7-14 days; we will follow-up at 48h/7d/14d. tagging Vanguard lead once tickets are up.

ops-bot: created issues: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ANA-600, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ASH-2022, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RAJ-11.

claire: PR link (conntrack change): https://git.redwood.ai/infra/conntrack/pull/17. includes alert spike rule.

derek: draft peering retry PR: https://git.redwood.ai/serving/peering/pull/21. adding synthetic harness.

nina: recurrence analysis owner? nominate raj to run a 90-day deploy vs incident correlation.

raj: happy to own recurrence report. will post results and recommended gating by next Tue.

nina: final: i'll assemble a short follow-up sheet for CS and attach ticket links. thanks all — postmortem thread closed after CS ping.

olivia: ack, will prepare customer note when tickets are linked.

claire: ack.

raj: ack.
